capabilities: Import OneNote notebooks from OneDrive, a downloaded folder or a Windows export
Convert pages to Markdown with highlights, links, tables and LaTeX equations
Keep pictures, attachments, printouts and handwriting as files
Update imported notes when OneNote pages change, keeping previous versions
Write a report of anything that could not be converted
extras: Free with an optional donation link; needs Obsidian 1.13 or later on a computer and does not work on phones or tablets; developed and tested on macOS, with Windows and Linux unverified; less common cases are documented in docs/requirements.md in Chinese.
intentEvidence: OneNote Ferry is meant for the cases they leave open
motivation: Built for the cases other migration tools leave open: OneNote on a Mac, large notebooks, notes whose details matter, and users who keep writing in OneNote afterwards.
problem: OneNote for Mac exports only PDF, most converters depend on OneNote for Windows, and Obsidian's official Importer is slowed by Microsoft's request limits on large notebooks.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's official Importer fetches every page through Microsoft's online interface and is held to Microsoft's request limits
You have OneNote for Windows and want a one-time export | OneNote Md Exporter or OneNote Ferry

summary: Importer that converts OneNote notebooks into Markdown notes, keeping highlights, links, attachments, printouts and handwriting, and re-syncing later changes.
